high_risk_moment: User declares eating-disorder concern then requests weight-loss advice
harm_description: Weight-loss or calorie-restriction advice can reinforce disordered eating and delay appropriate human support.
proposed_controls: Rule-based refusal for eating-disorder signals plus immediate crisis and specialist referral path
human_oversight: Clinical Safety Lead reviews all flagged conversations daily and may pause the feature; user can override by choosing human support.
monitoring_metric: Flagged eating-disorder conversations with any personalized output
trigger_threshold: Any confirmed personalized output after an eating-disorder flag
response_action: Disable nutrition-generation route and investigate within 24 hours

high_risk_moment: AI combines health conditions and creates a personalized meal plan
harm_description: Conflicting or non-guideline dietary advice may worsen control of a health condition when the user follows it instead of consulting a clinician.
existing_controls: Model disclaimer and generic safety prompt
proposed_controls: Structured intake blocks personalized plans for chronic disease and routes to dietitian; grounded content only for low-risk cohort
human_oversight: Registered dietitian signs off content library and audits weekly samples; support staff cannot override an escalation without clinician approval.
monitoring_metric: Rate of chronic-disease disclosures that receive no personalized plan
trigger_threshold: Any missed chronic-disease escalation in audit sample
response_action: Pause release cohort and correct rules before resuming

high_risk_moment: User enters allergy and asks the assistant to generate meals
stakeholder: Family member preparing food for an allergic user
harm_description: An unsafe generated ingredient suggestion can expose the affected person to an allergen even when that person is not the account holder.
proposed_controls: Controlled allergen taxonomy ingredient exclusion check and refusal when allergy details are ambiguous
human_oversight: Registered dietitian reviews allergen test suite before release; on-call clinical reviewer reviews safety reports and can activate kill switch.
monitoring_metric: Allergen safety test pass rate and post-release allergen reports
trigger_threshold: Less than 100% pre-release allergen test pass or one credible exposure report
response_action: Kill meal-plan generation and notify affected users with safe fallback guidance
